sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    `Order Year`,
    MEASURE(`Order Count`) AS order_count,
    MEASURE(`Average Order Total`) AS average_order_total
  FROM ${target_catalog}.${target_schema}.mv_tpch_supply_chain_orders
  GROUP BY `Order Year`
)
SELECT
  `Order Year`,
  order_count,
  order_count / LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY `Order Year`) - 1 AS order_count_yoy_change,
  average_order_total,
  average_order_total / LAG(average_order_total) OVER (ORDER BY `Order Year`) - 1 AS average_order_total_yoy_change
FROM yearly
ORDER BY `Order Year`
